steps.download: 1. Download the sample CSV and open it in Excel, Google Sheets or LibreOffice.
steps.fill: 2. Replace the example rows with your own (keep the first row of column names), then save it as CSV.
steps.upload: 3. Upload the file, check the rows below, fix anything marked red, and save.

imports.onlyProblems_one: Show only the row with a problem
imports.onlyProblems_other: Show only the {{count}} rows with problems
imports.fixProblems_one: 1 row needs fixing before saving (marked red).
imports.fixProblems_other: {{count}} rows need fixing before saving (marked red).
imports.serverProblems_one: Nothing was saved: 1 row has a problem. Fix it and save again.
imports.serverProblems_other: Nothing was saved: {{count}} rows have problems. Fix them and save again.
imports.missingColumns: The file has no {{columns}} column. Start from the sample CSV and keep its first row.
imports.emptyFile: The file has no rows below the column names.
imports.tooManyRows: The file has {{count}} rows; import at most {{max}} at a time. Split it into smaller files.
imports.ignoredColumns: These columns are not used and were skipped: {{columns}}.

errors.unknownProduct: No product with this SKU or barcode
errors.notStocked: Stock is not tracked for this product

products.title: Import products
products.subtitle: Add many products at once from a CSV file.

columns.required: Required: name, unit (as in Units, e.g. pcs or kg) and selling_price. Every other column can be left blank.
columns.sku: sku: leave blank to number it automatically (P000001, P000002, …).
columns.barcode: barcode: the maker's barcode; leave blank to generate a shop barcode. Separate several with | (e.g. 8941100500019|OIL-1).
columns.masters: category and brand: written by name; ones that do not exist yet are created when you save.
columns.tax: tax_rate: a tax rate name or percent (e.g. 15); blank uses the business default.
columns.type: type: standard or service. track_stock: yes or no.
columns.openingStock: opening_stock: the quantity you have now (e.g. 20, or 2.5 for kg); it is saved as opening stock. Leave blank for none.
columns.openingCost: opening_cost: cost per unit of that stock; leave blank to use purchase_price.

stock.title: Opening stock from CSV
stock.hint: Download the sample (your products without stock), fill in opening_stock and opening_cost (blank cost = purchase price), and upload it. The rows appear below to check before saving.
stock.missingColumns: The file needs a sku (or barcode) column and an opening_stock column. Start from the sample CSV.
stock.noProducts: Every product already has stock; the sample has only the column names.
